name: PaXini TORA DOUBLE ONE Model X
summary: A wheeled humanoid with tactile 18-DOF hands on a foldable four-wheel-drive chassis that can lift its legs over obstacles, rated 6.5 kg per arm, for logistics, inspection and mobile manipulation.

germany.statusNote: RBTX (igus, Germany) lists the Model X as its own article with a contact button instead of a price and a usual delivery time of 3 weeks.

priceOther.market: AIFitLab (US reseller), variant TORA DOUBLE ONE (X), backordered

specs.label: Perception
specs.quote: Die Wahrnehmung kombiniert RGB RGB‑D und LiDAR‑SLAM für Kartierung Hinderniserkennung und Umfeldbewertung.

notes: The maker describes the obstacle-crossing chassis as built to adapt to complex terrain; no slope, step height or outdoor rating is published, so rough ground is left open.
Tactile dexterous hands (18 DOF each) are part of the listed DOF.
